title: 10 SECRET CODES FOR CHATGPT 🤯
description:
Follow me + comment CODES and I’ll send you 100 more👇

These are 10 ChatGPT secret codes that you can paste before any question to get better answers.

Type the code first, then your prompt.

T-L-D-R
Takes any massive chunk of text and compresses it into the smallest possible version without losing any important details.

ELI10
Explains the topic like you’re 10 years old.

REDTEAM
Challenges your idea, finds weak spots, and plays devil’s advocate.

HORMOZI
Turns the answer into a direct business-growth style breakdown.

/human
Makes the response sound more natural and less robotic.

80/20
Finds the easiest, highest-leverage path to your goal.

SOCRATES
Teaches you through questions instead of just giving the answer.

LINDYMODE
Focuses on proven, long-term principles instead of hype.

Want better answers from ChatGPT?
